decisions.reason: The online customer portal lies outside the firm's core paper-based display manufacturing knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the digital service, and its minimal website presence suggests weak early results.

The cardboard packaging display solution builds directly on existing cardboard display expertise, and winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 signals that the firm successfully assimilated and applied the related knowledge.

The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display closely matches the firm's established knowledge in paper-based board displays and is actively presented, indicating the firm can interpret and learn from its early results.

The small cardboard counter display aligns with the firm's core temporary retail display capabilities and has a dedicated webpage, suggesting effective absorption and potential for further improvement.

The large freestanding cardboard information display leverages existing paper-based board material and design knowledge, and its own webpage indicates commercial confidence from assimilated early results.
